segments.an7.81:1.3: Āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, vinaye kho pana ṭhito hoti asaṃhīro, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ … pe … akasiralābhī, āsavānaṃ khayā … pe … sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.an7.81:1.10: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhatī”ti.
